messages:
samir: fyi support case 3287 — ACME seeing spikes after our failover. They report requests hitting eu-west when their region is us-east, adds ~220ms. sample logs attached.

priya: thanks — case id? any auth errors or 5xx?

samir: case 3287. no 5xx, timeouts mostly. auth OK. header shows routed-region: eu-west though client sets x-pref-region: us-east.

support-bot: alert: scaling-policy-fallback triggered for org acme (10:12 UTC) :rotating_light: 

marco: can you paste failover policy for their svc? priority + weights might be off.

samir: here's the policy they applied:
```json
{"failover": [{"region":"eu-west","priority":1,"weight":100,"sticky":true},{"region":"us-east","priority":0,"weight":0,"sticky":false}]}
```

priya: wait priority 0 for us-east but weight 0 and sticky false — that looks inverted. priority should be lower number = higher preference? our code treats higher priority value as fallback order (we changed in 2025). so this config will favor eu-west.

jo: yep, this is the root cause — docs ambiguous during migration. We need to either update SDK or set validation to reject mismatched combos where preferred region has weight==0.

marco: repro steps for SRE: curl with header + show route selected
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Pref-Region: us-east" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-7b"}' -v
```
Look for header: X-Routed-Region

samir: attached example response: X-Routed-Region: eu-west

priya: quick mitigation: set sticky:true for us-east and give weight>0 OR swap priorities to reflect new semantics. I'll push a validation rule to staging.

jo: also flagging for billing — cross-region adds egress costs. finance notified.

marco: assigning to @priya for hotfix + @samir to update the support case with repro steps. We should add a small log sample and note affected customer orgs (2). ETA 1h?

priya: on it. creating PR #5423 to enforce weight>0 for priority==0. will roll to staging then prod.

support-bot: deploy started: pr-5423 -> staging :rocket:

samir: thx — I'll follow up once we verify with ACME.

priya: verified in staging: routes respect pref-region when weight>0. Will schedule prod deploy after a short smoke test.

marco: nice. Also let's add a quick sentence to docs about new priority semantics to avoid future flips.

jo: noted. closing for now, will reopen if ACME still sees cross-region.

samir: ACME confirmed fixed after config change. closing case.
